_comment: US-3307: the ONE classification of what an inventory_items.brand value actually is.
This file is DATA, not code, because three runtimes have to agree on it and they
cannot import each other: the Vite frontend (src/lib/brand-field-classification.ts),
Node scripts (scripts/lib/brand-field-classification.mjs) and the vitest guards.
Same trick src/lib/ebay-aspect-registry.json already uses. Before this file there
were three separate hardcoded lists that had already drifted apart:
scripts/brand-kb-gap.mjs NOT_A_BRAND        12 values
src/lib/placeholder-brand.ts                18 values
services/.../style-code-prospect.ts          3 values
and only the first one knew that Norman Rockwell is a licensor.
THE LIST IS NAMED, NEVER HEURISTIC. A classifier that guessed 'this looks like a
material' would eventually swallow MOTHER, FRAME, Quince or Vince, all ordinary
words and all real houses, and a silently swallowed brand is invisible. Every key
below is a decision someone recorded with a reason. An unrecognised value is
ALWAYS classified 'maker', which is the safe direction: it gets proposed for the
brand KB and a human sees it.
Keys are brandKey()-normalized: lowercased, then everything outside [a-z0-9]
dropped. So 'N/A' -> 'na', 'No Brand' -> 'nobrand', and a punctuation-only value
-> '' which is the 'blank' class. That normalizer is shared too; it must stay
identical to brandKey() in services/edge-functions/src/lib/brand-normalize.ts.

maker.label: A maker
maker.meaning: Resolves to a company that actually made the garment. The default for anything not named below.

licensor.label: A licensor
licensor.meaning: An artist, estate, property or franchise whose image is licensed onto a blank somebody else made. Printed on the front, not sewn at the collar.
licensor.guidance: That name is licensed onto the shirt, not the company that made it. Check the neck or side tag for the maker.

material.label: A material
material.meaning: A fibre or a fabric. What the garment is made of, not who made it.
material.guidance: That is what the garment is made of. The maker is on the neck or care tag.

retailer.label: A retailer
retailer.meaning: A shop or a marketplace that sells other companies' goods. Usually typed because it is where the item was sourced.
retailer.guidance: That is where the item came from, not who made it. The maker is on the neck or care tag.

descriptor.label: A descriptor
descriptor.meaning: An era, a style word or a condition word. Describes the garment, not its maker.
descriptor.guidance: That describes the garment rather than naming its maker. Check the neck or care tag.

unbranded.label: Unbranded
unbranded.meaning: A REAL ANSWER: this garment carries no maker's label. eBay ships Unbranded and Handmade as valid Brand aspect values, so a seller who typed one meant it. Never treat this as a missing value.

unknown.label: Not known
unknown.meaning: An explicit stand-in for 'nobody could tell'. Someone looked at the field and had no answer.
unknown.guidance: No maker is recorded yet. Read the neck tag, or mark the item Unbranded if it genuinely carries no label.

blank.label: Empty
blank.meaning: The field was never filled in at all. Distinct from 'unknown', where somebody answered and the answer was no answer.
blank.guidance: No maker is recorded yet. Read the neck tag, or mark the item Unbranded if it genuinely carries no label.

values.label: Norman Rockwell
values.reason: An illustrator who died in 1978. His estate licenses images onto blanks; the FTC register returns nothing for the name. Refused from brand_knowledge by 00783. The maker is whatever is at the collar, usually Gildan, Hanes or a band-tee blank.

values.label: Cashmere
values.reason: A fibre, not a maker. Recorded in 00731.

values.label: Genuine leather
values.reason: A material claim printed on a tag, not a maker.

values.label: Sterling silver
values.reason: A metal purity claim off a hallmark, not a maker.

values.label: 925 silver
values.reason: A metal purity claim off a hallmark, not a maker.

values.label: Goodwill
values.reason: A thrift chain. Typed because it is where the item was sourced.

values.label: TJ Maxx
values.reason: An off-price retailer; it sells other makers' goods and puts no name at the collar.

values.label: Vintage
values.reason: An era word. Note the real houses that survive this list because the match is exact: Vintage Havana keys as vintagehavana.

values.label: Retro
values.reason: An era word. The Original Retro Brand keys as originalretrobrand and is unaffected.

values.label: Single stitch
values.reason: A construction detail used for dating.

values.label: Made in USA
values.reason: Origin text off the care label. The ai-extract prompt already forbids copying generic tag text into brand.

values.label: Made in Italy
values.reason: Origin text off the care label.

values.label: Union made
values.reason: Union label text, which dates a piece and never names it.

values.label: No tag
values.reason: States that the tag is gone, which is a reason we do not know rather than a claim that the garment had no maker.

values.label: Tagless
values.reason: States that the tag is gone or printed rather than sewn.

values.label: One size
values.reason: A size, landed in the wrong column.

values.label: Unbranded
values.reason: eBay ships Unbranded as a real Brand aspect value for a garment that carries no maker's label. A seller who typed it answered the question.

values.label: Handmade
values.reason: eBay ships Handmade as a Brand aspect value too. It means an individual made it and there is no commercial label, which is an answer, not a gap.

values.label: No brand
values.reason: What the sell-through RPC and capitalVelocity() coalesce an EMPTY brand to before the row reaches the client. It is generated, not typed, so it means 'nobody filled this in' rather than 'this garment has no label'.

values.label: None
values.reason: Genuinely ambiguous between 'no label' and 'not filled in', which is exactly why the composer offers an explicit Unbranded button instead of leaving the seller to type this. Classed as not-known because the safe reading never publishes a claim about the garment.

values.label: N/A
values.reason: An explicit non-answer. Covers 'n/a', 'N.A.' and 'na'; NA-KD keys as nakd and survives.

values.label: null
values.reason: A serialization artifact that reached the column as text.

values.label: undefined
values.reason: A serialization artifact that reached the column as text.

values.label: Not visible
values.reason: A model placeholder: the tag was in no photo.

values.label: Illegible
values.reason: A model placeholder: the tag was there and could not be read.

values.label: Placeholder
values.reason: A staging value from a spreadsheet import.

values.label: Blank
values.reason: A staging value from a spreadsheet import.
